name: GPU 3D Mip Chain Generation
definition: A GPU primitive that fills a 3D texture's mip chain by generating each level via per-(level, z-slice) render passes, using GPURenderPassColorAttachment.depthSlice to target specific Z-slices.
summary: GPU 3D Mip Chain Generation fills 3D texture mip chains via per-slice render passes, differing from atlas mipmap by operating on contiguous volumes rather than 2D atlases.
